description: Publish a 3D file as a Verse scene and return a link that opens in any browser, from a single product to a walkable building or a whole city. Use it when you have a public http(s) URL, or a path on this machine (local server only). If the user has the file but no public URL, use create_upload_link; to re-share an existing scene, use create_share_link. Parameters: `source` links must be directly downloadable (Dropbox dl=1, Google Drive 'anyone with the link', S3/R2/GCS presigned). Leave `kind`, `as` and `path` unset unless the guess would be wrong, e.g. a Gaussian-splat .ply is `kind` 'splat'. `visibility` applies once the build finishes. `wait_seconds` 0 returns as soon as the upload is accepted. Formats: GLB, glTF, FBX, OBJ, IFC, USD/USDZ, PLY, SPLAT, LAS/LAZ/E57. Limits: up to 1 GB per file on the free plan and 20 GB on paid plans; 20 uploads an hour per account, and files over 500 MB count against a smaller hourly allowance (2 on free). Files over 100 MB go up in resumable parts with progress notifications. A product usually builds in seconds; a large walkable scene can take many minutes, in which case status comes back 'compiling' and you poll get_scene_status. Every call creates a new scene in the user's workspace, unlisted unless `visibility` says otherwise. Requires sign-in (connector sign-in, or VERSE_API_KEY for the local server).

as.description: Say what the file is: a 'product' (a single object) or a walkable 'interior'/'building'/'exterior'. Local uploads only; otherwise detected.

bake.description: Bake lighting on the server before building (for live-lit GLBs). Slower.

kind.description: Force the file kind when the extension is ambiguous (e.g. 'splat' for a Gaussian-splat .ply). Normally detected from the bytes.

name.description: Optional slug used as the scene id prefix, lowercase letters, digits, - and _.

path.description: 'fidelity' publishes the model as-is (best for single products); 'streamed' builds a streamed scene (best for big walkable scenes). Normally decided automatically.

resumable.description: Force resumable multi-part upload (default: automatic above 100 MB). Use on flaky connections.

source.description: Local file path (e.g. ~/Models/villa.glb) or a public http(s) URL to a 3D file.

visibility.description: Set after the build finishes. Needs an account token. 'private' scenes only open with a share link from create_share_link.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the build before returning the job id (0 = return right after upload).

name: upload_scene

arUrl.description: USDZ link for iPhone AR, products only.

fixes.description: Repairs Verse applied to the file, if any.

kind.description: How it was published: 'fidelity' (as-is product) or 'streamed' (walkable scene).

link.description: Link that opens the scene in any browser.

visibility.description: public, unlisted or private, when set.

title: Publish a 3D scene and get a Verse link
